title: Brian Springer - Spin
summary: Brian Springer's documentary Spin, built entirely from unauthorized satellite feeds of politicians and newscasters before they went on air during the 1992 US presidential election. It exposes the behind-the-scenes construction of media reality.
why: Recommended as a revealing look at how politicians and news anchors behave off camera and how packaged news feeds were produced.

quote.text: You might like Spin , a 1995 documentary composed of unauthorized behind the scenes footage
